description: Agent Action Receipts API: Issue and verify tamper-evident signed audit receipts for AI agent actions (integrity proof only). (Endpoint: POST /v1/agent-action-receipts/issue)

action_input.description: Structured tool input payload; canonicalized and SHA-256 hashed into input_sha256 without storing raw values in the receipt.

action_output.description: Optional tool output payload; when provided, canonicalized and SHA-256 hashed into output_sha256.

agent_id.description: Unique identifier of the AI agent executing the tool action.

issued_at_epoch.description: Optional Unix epoch timestamp in seconds to override the issuance time (defaults to current server time).

kid.description: Optional key identifier placed in the receipt header (defaults to private_jwk.kid if present, otherwise 'v1').

policy_decision.description: Guardrail policy outcome recorded for this tool invocation (allow, repaired, escalated, or blocked; default 'allow').

prev_receipt_hash.description: SHA-256 hex hash of the preceding receipt_token in the chain, or 'genesis' for the first link (default 'genesis').

private_jwk.description: Optional Ed25519 (OKP) or P-256 (EC) private JWK for asymmetric EdDSA/ES256 receipt signing instead of HMAC-SHA256.

secret.description: HMAC signing secret (min 16 chars; or omit from body and pass via X-Tinplate-Signing-Secret header, or provide private_jwk).

session_id.description: Optional conversation, trace, or workflow session identifier associated with the action.

tool_name.description: Name of the tool or capability invoked by the agent.

ttl_seconds.description: Optional receipt validity duration in seconds (60 to 315,360,000); omit for a non-expiring receipt.

name: tinplate_agent_action_receipts
